rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: iDig DNS exposes 14 professional DNS diagnostic tools from the iDig API. Capabilities include DNS record lookups, DNSSEC chain-of-trust validation, email security auditing with SPF/DKIM/DMARC grading, SSL certificate checks, propagation monitoring across 16 global resolvers, TTL advisory, zone consistency checking, and subdomain discovery. The remote MCP endpoint runs on Railway with the iDig REST API on AWS Lambda.
